BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund Company Profile ( Get Free Report ) BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc is a closed-end municipal bond fund listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol MUJ. The fund seeks to provide current income that is exempt from regular U.S. federal income tax and New Jersey personal income tax.

The fund invests primarily in long-term municipal obligations issued by or on behalf of New Jersey and its municipalities, authorities, and other governmental entities. Its portfolio may include bonds that finance public infrastructure and services such as schools, transportation systems, utilities, health care facilities, and housing projects.
